name: Integer Lorenzo Predictor
description: Plain integer N-D Lorenzo predictor (delta coding / prefix sum). Forward: computes per-element delta from neighbor(s) using 1-D, 2-D, or 3-D inclusion-exclusion. Inverse: prefix sum to reconstruct. Lossless; output is the same signed type as input. Optional block-local reset period (setBlockSize) enables parallel decompression and mirrors the cuSZp 1-D block design (independent reimplementation).

config.name: blockSize
config.description: Block-local reset period (elements). 0 = default N-D behavior (full-array delta). >0 forces the 1-D path, restarting the prediction chain every n elements. cuSZp uses n=32. Must be in [1, 1024] when non-zero.
